## Flagship Platform & Core Engineering Project

- [Kodersolution.com - Developer Platform](https://kodersolution.com/) ([Case Study](https://maksudur.dev/projects/kodersolution/)): 
  - **Role**: Founder & Lead Engineer (2023 - Present)
  - **Live URL**: https://kodersolution.com
  - **Architecture**: Next.js (App Router, SSR, ISR) frontend coupled with a high-throughput Laravel REST API backend (`api.kodersolution.com`), Redis distributed cache, and MySQL database.
  - **Overview**: Full-stack developer platform and learning ecosystem featuring technical articles, programming tutorials, student learning tracks, community discussion forums, and automated split-payment billing.

- [Hire Laravel Developer](https://maksudur.dev/services/hire-laravel-developer/): Scalable enterprise Laravel web applications, queue workers, custom packages, and performance tuning.

- [Payment Gateway Integration](https://maksudur.dev/services/payment-gateway-integration/): Multi-currency payment gateways, bank adapters, transaction locking, webhooks, and error mapping.
- [Telegram Mini App Development](https://maksudur.dev/services/telegram-mini-app-development/): Embedded React/Vite interfaces within Telegram, initData security verification, and bot automation.
- [Laravel API Development](https://maksudur.dev/services/laravel-api-development/): Token-based Sanctum/Passport OAuth2 APIs, OpenAPI documentation, and rate-limiting middlewares.
- [React & Laravel Development](https://maksudur.dev/services/react-laravel-development/): Full-stack web applications pairing Next.js / React frontends with Laravel REST API backends.
- [Linux Server Setup & DevOps](https://maksudur.dev/services/devops-and-server-setup/): AWS EC2 setup, aaPanel installation, Let's Encrypt SSL, Nginx web server configuration, and Linux server management.

## Other Featured Engineering Projects

- [Peaklancer Freelance Marketplace](https://maksudur.dev/projects/peaklancer/): Digital marketplace with escrow payment workflows, milestone dispatches, and real-time chat.
- [Fintech Payment Gateway Service](https://maksudur.dev/projects/payment-gateway/): High-throughput transaction routing service with banking networks, Redis distributed locks, and error normalization.
- [School ERP Administration Portal](https://maksudur.dev/projects/school/): School management system handling student lifecycles, schedule matrix validation, and queued PDF generation.
- [HRM & Payroll Engine](https://maksudur.dev/projects/hrm/): Enterprise payroll system managing work shifts, tax calculations, and encrypted salary databases.
- [Garments ERP Supply Chain System](https://maksudur.dev/projects/garments-erp/): Production tracking portal for textile manufacturing, raw material inventory, and WebSocket Kanban boards.
- [Point of Sale (POS) Offline System](https://maksudur.dev/projects/pos/): Retail register platform operating offline with browser IndexedDB caching and cloud sync.
- [Money Management Financial Ledger](https://maksudur.dev/projects/money-management/): Privacy-first personal financial manager with receipt parsing and double-entry accounting models.
- [Sportslover.Live Real-Time Coverage](https://maksudur.dev/projects/sportslover/): Live sports blogging and match tracking platform powered by WebSockets and Next.js ISR.
